title: Attack Speed and Animation Times
intro: How weapon speed, skill animations, and Booster affect attack timing in MapleStory Classic World, including fixed mage timing and 30 ms cadence notes.

blocks.p: The name on a weapon covers one or more numbered tiers. Two weapons with the same name can still attack at different speeds, which is why skill pages show the number beside the name: Fast (4) finishes an ordinary attack 30 ms before Fast (5).
Ordinary attack times use a sword, axe, mace, dagger, claw or bow swing. Attacks per minute counts completed attacks in 60 seconds.

Each tier below shows the time for one ordinary attack and who can stand on it. Tiers with a weapon listed in the last column are ones a player can reach. Tiers 11 and 12 take as long as tier 10, and no weapon in the game is slower than Slow (8).

blocks.p: Your weapon type decides your range. The best tier a type can reach is its fastest weapon with the matching Booster.

blocks.p: A matching weapon Booster moves your weapon **two tiers** at every skill level, so one SP already gives the full speed. Extra levels lower the HP and MP cost and extend the duration from 100 seconds at level 1 to 300 seconds at level 20.

ul: Booster must match the weapon you hold. Sword Booster does nothing for an axe.
Earlier skills benefit once you have the matching Booster: a Bandit's Double Stab speeds up with Dagger Booster.
Spell Booster (F/P Mage and I/L Mage) moves eligible spells one tier at levels 1 to 10 and two tiers from level 11. Cleric and Priest do not get it.

blocks.h2: Skill animation times, slowest to fastest

blocks.p: Skills that use your weapon's attack follow the ladder. Warrior, Bowman and Thief skills with their own animation have their own times, but weapon speed still scales them. Magician spells stay at Normal (6) with any weapon. Each row shows the slowest and fastest weapon a class can use, then the best case with Booster.

blocks.p: Open any skill page for its full table at every speed.
Speed and W.ATK trade against each other, so compare total damage per minute before you swap weapons. Two examples we already calculate in the class guides:

ul: **Level 30 Thief with a claw, no Booster yet.** Meba (Faster 3, 19 W.ATK) throws Lucky Seven in 660 ms. Adamantium Guards (Fast 4, 23 W.ATK) takes 720 ms. With Wolbi stars, Meba reaches 40,630 damage per minute against 41,671: one speed tier almost cancels a 4 W.ATK gap.

**Level 70 Bandit, Booster on.** Golden River (Faster 3) reaches speed 1 and gets 90 Savage Blows per minute in our damage calculator against Kandine's 83, about 5% more damage on the same stats. Its 65 STR requirement costs about 56 LUK, which leaves Kandine about 1% ahead.

blocks.p: For Magician jobs, the displayed speed of a wand, staff, sword or umbrella does not change a spell's animation time. Every timed spell uses the Normal (6) tier: 810 ms for Magic Claw, Energy Bolt, Fire Arrow, Cold Beam and Holy Arrow. Pick a mage weapon for its Magic Attack and stats. F/P and I/L Spell Booster can still shorten eligible spells to 750 ms at levels 1 to 10 and 720 ms from level 11.

blocks.p: The frame durations and their attack-speed conversion are confirmed for ordinary COT2 characters, including Savage Blow. We still round displayed times up to 30 ms steps; that final rounding remains a model. The full timing formula is in Explaining the Damage Formula.
